title: Typesense Search Parameters
description: Schema for Typesense search query parameters

q.description: Query text to search for. Use '*' for wildcard searches

query_by.description: Comma-separated list of fields to search in

prefix.description: Enable prefix searching. Can be boolean or comma-separated field list

sort_by.description: Comma-separated list of fields to sort by with :asc or :desc

facet_by.description: Comma-separated list of fields to facet by

max_facet_values.description: Maximum number of facet values to return per facet field

facet_query.description: Filter facet values based on query

num_typos.description: Number of typos allowed per query field

group_limit.description: Maximum number of results per group

include_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in response

exclude_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to exclude from response

highlight_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to highlight

highlight_full_fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to fully highlight

highlight_affix_num_tokens.description: Number of tokens around highlighted text to include

snippet_threshold.description: Minimum characters required for snippet generation

pinned_hits.description: Comma-separated list of document IDs to pin to top

hidden_hits.description: Comma-separated list of document IDs to hide from results

limit_hits.description: Maximum number of hits to return

vector_query.description: Vector search query in format 'field:(vector, k:n)'

remote_embedding_num_tries.description: Number of retries for remote embedding generation
